G02.production_limitation: Verified with synthetic binary IPFIX/NetFlow, exporter restart, and parser error recovery; physical router NetFlow feed pending Phase 9.

G03.production_limitation: None (SQLite transactional ACID outbox and deduplication window verified).

G04.name: Federated Learning Privacy (SecAgg+)
G04.production_limitation: Verified 5-of-7 quorum and abort on dropout; no plaintext downgrade permitted.

G05.name: Differential Privacy Accounting
G05.production_limitation: Verified cumulative (eps, delta) accounting, persistence, and budget exhaustion.

G06.name: Model Integrity & Compatibility
G06.production_limitation: Feature schema digest and artifact checksum verified; incompatible/corrupted models rejected.

G07.name: Detection Utility & Operational Alerting
G07.production_limitation: Held-out test performance verified; 7-day shadow operational monitoring on live traffic pending Phase 9.

G08.name: Manual Response Safety & Policy Engine
G08.production_limitation: Human authorization, scoping, TTL, and rollback verified; physical router ACL integration pending Phase 9.

G09.name: Reliability & Failure Recovery
G09.production_limitation: F01-F30 fault matrix passing in development; multi-AZ cloud failover pending Phase 9.

G10.name: Consortium Ledger & Governance

G11.name: Supply Chain Security & Dual Signatures

G12.name: Quantum Research Isolation

G14.name: Dataset Integrity & Leakage Prevention

G15.name: Hierarchical Model Reliability (FCS-HMD)
